core_obligations: Consider the commutative square with top row R_1 x_{s_1,U,t_1} R_1 to R_1 induced by c_1, bottom row R_2 x_{s_2,U,t_2} R_2 to R_2 induced by c_2, and vertical arrows a x a and a. By varieties-lemma-closure-image-product-map the closure of the image of the left vertical arrow a x a is, set theoretically, Z x_{s_2,U,t_2} Z. By commutativity of the square the bottom horizontal arrow maps the image of a x a into the image of a, whose closure is Z; since c_2 is continuous, the bottom arrow maps the closure Z x_{s_2,U,t_2} Z into Z. Conclusion: c_2(Z x_{s_2,U,t_2} Z) is contained in Z set theoretically.
proof_roadmap: Set up the commutative square relating the composition arrows on R_1 and R_2 with a x a and a (proof lines 1765-1771).
Identify the closure of the image of a x a with Z x Z set theoretically via varieties-lemma-closure-image-product-map (proof lines 1772-1775).
Push the containment through the commutative square and continuity of c_2 to get c_2(Z x Z) inside Z (proof line 1776).
